ideas.title: Paint Mechs for Battles
ideas.hook: Every mech starts as a bare grey frame. Paint armor plates onto it with spray cans, and every painted panel becomes real armor, so how you paint decides where you can take a hit.
core_loop: Spray paint panels on your mech in the garage
Painted areas turn into armor with their own colour bonus (red = power, blue = shield, gold = cash)
Fight another player's mech in a short arena round
Win parts and new paint colours, then repaint for the next fight
ideas.twist: Hits chip the paint off, and bare spots take double damage, so a quick mid-fight touch-up spray can win a fight.
ideas.why_now: Robots / mechs is the fastest-climbing theme at 2.17 momentum (+0.80 this week), led by Steel Fighters (14.2K CCU, 50 days old) and [🎃] Create a Robot Fighter (5.0K). Paint / create holds 2.21 (+0.13) with [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] (21.2K) and Backseat Rally (17.0K), and Paint + Robots is one of the top open gaps (score 5.84).
ideas.differentiator: Robot fighters let you pick parts; here the paint job is the build, so every player's mech looks and plays different.

ideas.title: Bat Robots for Bolts
ideas.hook: A junkyard pitching machine fires broken robots at you. Swing your bat, send them flying across the scrapyard, and collect the bolts that rain out where they land.
core_loop: Step up to the plate as robots are pitched
Time your swing to launch them for distance
Collect bolts scattered along the landing zone
Spend bolts on bats and swing power to reach farther zones
ideas.twist: Some robots grab the bat on the way past, so you have to swing early or late to shake them off, and those ones drop rare cores.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.05 momentum (+0.16 this week) with Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (23.6K CCU, 14 days old), [🎃] Throw Food For Animals (21.0K) and Cat Battles 🐾 (13.9K). Robots / mechs jumped +0.80 to 2.17, and the "___ for ___" title formula leads all formulas at 3.26.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games throw food or objects; here the target is a robot that fights back mid-swing, which adds timing to a one-button loop.

ideas.title: 1 Mech vs Everyone
ideas.hook: Each round one random player pilots a giant mech and everyone else has to survive a short minigame on its map: hide, sabotage its legs, or race it to the exit.
core_loop: Join the lobby and get picked as pilot or runner
Play a 2-minute round on one of the rotating maps
Runners earn coins for surviving, the pilot earns for catches
Unlock mech skins and runner gadgets between rounds
ideas.twist: Runners can climb onto the mech and unscrew panels; if enough panels come off, the mech collapses and the runners win the round.
retention: Season leaderboard for pilots and runners
ideas.why_now: Party / minigames rose +0.24 to 1.18 with 🎃 [HALLOWEEN] Hunting Together RPG (4.6K CCU) and 1v1 Minigame Duel (1.0K), and Party + Robots is an open gap (score 2.87). Robots / mechs is the top theme mover at 2.17 (+0.80) behind Steel Fighters (14.2K).
ideas.differentiator: Asymmetric round games use a monster or killer; a pilotable mech that runners can take apart gives both sides a goal.

ideas.title: Sort Coins for Rares
ideas.hook: Buckets of loose change pour onto your sorting table. Drag coins into the right slots fast, and spot the rare misprints and gold coins hidden in the pile for your collection book.
core_loop: Tip a bucket of coins onto the table
Sort them into slots before the timer runs out for cash
Pull rare coins into your coin book as you spot them
Buy bigger buckets from richer places (piggy bank, fountain, casino vault)
ideas.twist: Stack 5 of the same coin and they merge into the next coin up, so you choose between selling fast and building a rarer coin.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is at 2.04 momentum (+0.26 this week) with [🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 (32.8K CCU) and +1 Money Per Click 💸 (8.9K). Collect / index sits at 1.8 (-0.17) behind Break and Steal an Egg (112.6K) and [🎃] Eat Everything In A Grocery Store (7.2K).
inspired_by: [🎃] Eat Everything In A Grocery Store
ideas.differentiator: Money games click for cash; this turns money into the collectible itself, with a coin book to fill and a skill-based sort.

ideas.title: +1 Tire Size Per Jump
ideas.hook: Drive a tiny truck off ramps. Every jump gives your tires +1 size, and bigger tires let you roll over cars, buses and eventually whole buildings.
core_loop: Hit ramps on the course to gain +1 tire size
Roll over obstacles that block smaller trucks
Reach a new zone gate once your tires are big enough
Rebirth for a tire multiplier and a new truck body
ideas.twist: Tires that get too big for a tunnel get stuck, so some shortcuts need you to deflate on purpose.
ideas.why_now: "+1 ___" titles climbed +0.47 to 2.46 and +1 stat per action is up +0.35 to 2.21 ([🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 13.9K, [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 13.7K). Vehicles rose +0.45 to 1.60 with [🎃] Bike For Egg! (25.9K) and [🎃] Bike Universe (25.4K).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow the player; here the vehicle grows, which changes what you can drive over in each zone.

ideas.title: Gatekeeper [Anomaly] 🏰
ideas.hook: You guard the only gate into the castle town. Check every traveller's papers, look for the monster in disguise, and decide who gets in before night falls.
core_loop: Inspect each traveller: face, papers, cart
Spot what's wrong (extra fingers, wrong seal, glowing eyes)
Let them in or turn them away
Survive the night with whoever you let inside
ideas.twist: Some anomalies only show under a torch, and torches burn down, so you have to choose who gets the light.
ideas.why_now: Job / shift is steady at 1.07 (+0.01) with Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 (10.1K CCU) and Aisles Of The Locust (7.6K), and anomaly shifts lead new games: 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (34.6K) and Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) (9.4K). Fantasy / medieval is up +0.17 to 1.49.
ideas.differentiator: Anomaly games are set in modern shops; a castle gate with medieval monsters is an unused setting for the same proven format.

ideas.title: Paint Shields for Knights
ideas.hook: Knights line up at your workshop wanting a crest on their shield. Paint the design they ask for, get paid by how close you get, then watch your shields fight in the tournament.
core_loop: Read the knight's request (lion, dragon, two colours)
Paint the shield with brushes and stencils
Get paid by match score and tips
Unlock new paints, stencils and richer noble customers
ideas.twist: Shields you painted show up in the castle tournament, and if a knight carrying your shield wins, every player who painted for him gets a bonus.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 2.21 (+0.13) with [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] (21.2K CCU) and [✍️]DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA (2.0K, new). Fantasy / medieval rose +0.17 to 1.49 with [🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense (5.0K) and Pixel Lineage (3.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Paint games pay for any picture; here customers want a specific crest, and your work keeps earning through the tournament.

ideas.title: Hero Hotline 📞
ideas.hook: You run the phones at a superhero agency. Calls come in (cat on a roof, giant robot downtown) and you pick which hero to send before the city map turns red.
core_loop: Answer emergency calls on the city map
Send the hero whose power fits the job
Earn cash and fame for every saved call
Recruit new heroes for your roster and upgrade the agency
ideas.twist: Heroes get tired and grumpy, so the best hero is not always free, and sending the wrong one can turn a small call into a bigger disaster.
ideas.why_now: Superheroes / powers is up +0.18 to 1.47 with Superhero Arena (8.8K CCU) and [🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense (5.0K). Job / shift holds 1.07 (+0.01) with high confidence, led by Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 (10.1K) and [UPD] Firefighting Sim 🚒 (8.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Hero games let you be the hero; here you manage a roster of them, which turns powers into a matching puzzle.

ideas.title: Sell Snacks to Aliens
ideas.hook: Open a snack cart at the edge of a space station. Every alien species wants something odd (slime on toast, frozen soda), and a happy alien pays in rare space coins.
core_loop: Read the alien's order from their speech bubble
Build the snack from ingredients on your counter
Serve it fast for coins and tips
Upgrade the cart into a full station diner
ideas.twist: Each species reacts to the wrong order differently: one shrinks your cart, one abducts a customer, one leaves a 5-star review anyway.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.90 (+0.10) with 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (34.6K CCU) and 🧸 My Small Business (12.9K, 10 days old). Space rose +0.42 to 1.41 with [🚀 SPACE] roll the world 🌎 (5.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games serve normal customers; aliens with strange orders and reactions give every serve a surprise.

ideas.title: Catch Lightning for Pets
ideas.hook: Chase storms with a glass jar. Catch lightning bolts as they strike, and each bottled bolt hatches into an electric pet, with rarer storms giving rarer pets.
core_loop: Follow the storm across the map
Stand where the bolt lands and catch it in your jar
Hatch bottled bolts into elemental pets
Use pets to unlock bigger storms in new zones
ideas.twist: Metal gear makes bolts hit you more often but also fries your jar, so you balance gear for catch rate against how many jars you lose.
ideas.why_now: Collect / index is at 1.8 (-0.17) behind Break and Steal an Egg (112.6K CCU) and [🎃] Bike For Egg! (25.9K), and Collect + Hatch is the top mechanic pair (16 new games, 170.6K CCU). Ice / fire / elements holds 1.22 (-0.13) with [UPD] Firefighting Sim 🚒 (8.3K); Disaster / weather (1.44, +0.35, low confidence) adds the storm setting.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Egg games collect eggs from the ground; catching the egg from a live lightning strike adds a positioning skill to every catch.
